title: CIRR reference-refinement benchmarks: 30-species grid and strand-aware follow-up (v1.5.0)
description: Accepted 30-species mitochondrial reference-refinement benchmark: eight methods, 870 ordered pairs and 167,040 main-grid rows, including MITObim. Archives separate forward-only main-grid and strand-aware follow-up source snapshots, reference inputs, accepted results, species-deletion sensitivity, auxiliary results and supplements. The preceding six-species analyses remain under plos-one/. See tcbb-20261102/RELEASE.txt for provenance, checksums and excluded BAM/assembly files.
